content: स्यन्दन {%a.%} (-ना|-नी|{%f.%}) [स्यन्द्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Going quickly, fleet; flowing. .²2 Quick, swift of foot, fleet; स्यन्दना नो चतुरगाः <ls>Ki. 15. 16</ls>. .{@-नः@} .²1 A war-chariot, a car or chariot in general; धर्मारण्यं प्रविशति गजः स्यन्दनालोक भीतः <ls>Ś. 1. 33</ls>; <ls>N. 15. 92</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 36</ls>. .²2 Air, wind. .²3 A kind of tree (तिनिश). .{@-नम्@} .²1 Flowing, trickling, oozing. .²2 Rushing, going or flowing quickly. .²3 Water. .{@-नी@} .²1 Saliva. .²2 The urinary passage.
